name: Night Flat Trade
summary: This EA trades during the Asian (night) session when the market is typically in a flat/ranging state. It identifies consolidation periods using ATR-based channel detection and enters breakout or mean-reversion trades within the defined night session window. All positions are closed before the high-volatility London session begins.
summary_zh: 该EA在亚洲时段（夜间）市场通常处于横盘整理时进行交易。它利用基于ATR的通道检测来识别盘整期，并在定义的夜间时段窗口内进行突破或均值回归交易。所有仓位在伦敦高波动性时段开始前平仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是在夜间亚洲交易时段捕捉市场的横盘整理行情，利用低波动性环境进行区间交易。入场条件基于ATR通道判断市场是否处于平坦状态，当价格触及通道上下轨时进行均值回归入场，或者在窄幅盘整后突破时顺势入场。出场条件包括止盈止损设置，以及强制在伦敦时段开盘前平仓所有持仓以规避跳空风险。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，支持同时多个交易品种。资金管理方面设有最大持仓限制和每日最大亏损限制，防止夜间意外波动造成过大损失。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is to capture flat/ranging market conditions during the Asian night session, exploiting the low-volatility environment for range-bound trading. Entry conditions are based on ATR channel detection to determine if the market is in a flat state, with mean-reversion entries when price touches the channel boundaries, or breakout entries following a narrow consolidation period. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, plus a mandatory close of all positions before the London session opens to avoid gap risks. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a percentage-based calculation tied to account balance, supporting multiple symbols simultaneously. Money management incorporates maximum position limits and daily maximum loss thresholds to prevent excessive losses from unexpected nighttime volatility spikes.

parameters.name: StartHour
parameters.description: 夜间交易开始时间（服务器时间）

parameters.name: EndHour
parameters.description: 夜间交易结束时间（服务器时间）

parameters.name: ATR_Period
parameters.description: ATR指标周期用于判断平坦状态
parameters.description_en: ATR period for flat market detection

parameters.name: FlatATRThreshold
parameters.description: ATR阈值低于此值判定为平坦市场
parameters.description_en: ATR threshold below which market is flat

parameters.name: LotSize
parameters.description_en: Initial lot size, martingale base quantity

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Group TP in points, close all at this profit

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number to distinguish trade instances

parameters.name: CloseBeforeLondon
parameters.description: 是否在伦敦时段前强制平仓
parameters.description_en: Force close positions before London session

pros: 利用夜间低波动性时段交易，避开高波动性新闻和事件风险
强制在伦敦开盘前平仓，有效规避跳空和滑点风险
设有每日最大亏损限制，防止意外行情造成重大损失
策略逻辑清晰，时段选择合理，适合自动化运行
pros_en: Exploits the low-volatility night session, avoiding high-volatility news and event risks
Mandatory close before London session effectively mitigates gap and slippage risks
Daily maximum loss limit prevents catastrophic losses from unexpected market moves
Clear strategy logic with sound session selection, suitable for fully automated operation
cons: 夜间低流动性可能导致点差扩大，增加交易成本和滑点风险
亚洲时段偶尔也会出现突发波动（如日本央行决议），策略缺乏新闻过滤
ATR阈值参数对市场状态判断可能不够精确，在不同品种上需要单独优化
均值回归策略在趋势突然出现时容易连续止损
cons_en: Nighttime low liquidity can cause spread widening, increasing trading costs and slippage risk
Asian session can occasionally experience sudden volatility (e.g., BOJ decisions) and the strategy lacks a news filter
ATR threshold parameter may not accurately judge market state and requires separate optimization per instrument
Mean-reversion approach is vulnerable to consecutive stop-losses when a trend suddenly emerges
improvements: 增加点差过滤器，当点差超过阈值时禁止开仓，避免在高成本环境下交易
加入重要经济日历事件过滤，避免在央行决议等重大事件前后交易
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to prohibit opening positions when the spread exceeds a threshold, avoiding trading in high-cost environments
Incorporate an economic calendar event filter to avoid trading around major events like central bank decisions

risk_points: 夜间低流动性时段点差扩大可能导致实际成交价远超预期
缺乏新闻事件过滤，在重大突发事件时可能遭受意外损失
ATR阈值固定参数在不同市场环境下可能失效
risk_points_en: Spread widening during low-liquidity night hours can cause actual fill prices to deviate significantly from expectations
Lack of news event filtering may lead to unexpected losses during major surprise events
Fixed ATR threshold parameters may fail under varying market conditions
